[[File:Traits.png|thumb|350x350px]]
'''Traits''' are modifiers that affect the unit’s performance in a fight; like more DMG to bosses, more range, etc. When you get a unit through summon, it might come with a trait or you can reroll traits through the use of '''Star Remnants'''.






<div style="text-align:right">
==How to use==
[[File:TraitsReroll.png|thumb|350x350px|left]]
To reroll Traits, find '''Wis''' around the map. She is outside the '''Evolve''' area.

As said above, the first way to reroll a Trait is by using '''Star Remnants'''. They can only be obtained through the '''Travelling Merchant Shop as of right now'''. The second way to reroll a Trait is by using '''Robux'''. 




<div style="text-align:left">
==List of Traits==
''<small>Help us expand this section!</small>''

===Nimble (25%)===
Units with this Trait attack faster

===Adept (10%)===
Units with this Trait levels up faster

===Superior (30%)===
Units with this Trait do more Damage to enemies

===Range (25%)===
Units with this Trait have increased Range

===Culling (5%)===
Units with this Trait do more Damage to enemies with '''low health'''

===Sniper (2.5%)===
Units with this Trait gets a massive Range enlargement over the '''Range''' Trait

===Godspeed (1.5%)===
Units with this Trait gets an even faster Attack Speed over the '''Nimble''' Trait

===Reaper (0.6%)===
Units with this Trait have increased Damage toward '''Bosses''', and a minor increase to normal enemies over the '''Superior''' Trait

==='''Golden (0.2%)'''===
Units with this Trait have an increased Money gain

===Divine (0.2%)===
Units with this Trait have a 20% '''Damage''' boost, 20% '''Range''' boost and increased '''Attack Speed'''
